title: Aerogel-it GmbH
content:
Aerogel-it is a Germany-based distributor and application specialist focused on aerogel products for construction and advanced industrial use. The company serves as the exclusive DACH distribution channel for selected silica aerogel blanket systems.

  • Coverage Area: Germany, Austria, and Switzerland
  • Focus Areas: Construction insulation, EV battery heat shields, thin aerogel boards, and high-performance thermal-protection solutions
  • Current Brands Represented: Beerenberg (Oryza BGT) and other aerogel solutions
  • Official Website: https://aerogel-it.de
review_notes: Directory profile reviewed for listing quality, category fit, and current public website availability.
